notes.title: Game strategies and tutorial videos.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25884671/a8d93ad36ab58bb4a219353e00e004e3032cb801.jpg[/img]
TAIKER is an old-school side scroller RPG.
It used to be a hard-core game in early development.
We tried to make it more friendly later.
But we know it not enough by some player's reaction now.

We are very sorry about the bad game experience.
And will listen all suggestions to make this game better.

To gain better game experience.
We recommended players use following strategy to play TAIKER.

1. Use skill "Force field" to push minions way from Peggy and avoid series of attack.
This skill also remove all bullet in screen.

2. Use roll left and right to escape from minions.
Peggy still got damage while rolling, but won't stop escaping.

3.Kill more minions and gain power cells to upgrade skill.
Also collect more battery to use while shield's low.

4. If Peggy's shield is low and out of battery.
Get a safe place, let the shield recover.

5. Upgrade these skills first.
Shield, Weapon, Full-Moon Slash and Fury.

If you don't know where to go and have trouble with puzzles.
Please watch these SPEED-RUN videos.

First stage
https://youtu.be/OiBRZuHBZxI
Firest Boss
https://youtu.be/BcyL7pJ3wfY
Second stage
https://youtu.be/RPW1626aeHg
Second Boss
https://youtu.be/jT8hmiMPcQo

notes.title: Version 1.0.2.c
notes.content:
We made a big mistake. 
Used an unlicensed song called "花が散る世界". 
From Bravely Default: Flying Fairy Original Soundtrack, Square Enix. 

We are very sorry about this big mistake. 
Already remove the unlicensed song from game and video.
And apologize to all players and Square Enix.

We've wrote to Squre Enix. Tell them all the truth.
And beg for forgiveness.

If Squre Enix wants to remove this game from steam.
We will contact with steam immediately.

Sorry about the big mistake again.
Please forgive us.

notes.title: TAIKER Released (Version 1.0.0.a)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25884671/447fafa0b18061756ec6526e904d0a36f489c582.jpg[/img]
Thanks all players who support TAIKER in green light and early access.
You are the power to make us keep developing.

This is a game made by a two-man team with limited resources.
We had to overcome a lot of difficult situations.
The development was terminated once.
Thankfully, we didn't give up.

The sub title of this game is resurrection.
It's about the game story.
And also means we overcome all the difficulties to complete the game.

Releasing this game doesn't mean the development's over.
We will keep updating and add more game modes.
Also more steam cards and achievements.

This is not a perfect game.
But we try to making it better.

Finally, thanks all people who help us.
